## GizmondoDroid v0.6

- Fixed flicker: games now draw into a back buffer that is only shown when a frame is complete
- New Settings > Graphics: frameskip (Off / Auto / Always 30 fps), texture filtering, fog, texture accuracy, CPU mode (JIT / interpreter)
- New Settings > Game keys: choose which keyboard key (Enter, Space, Esc, Ctrl, Z, X...) each Gizmondo button presses in the game
- Audio prebuffer and frame skipping from v0.5 retained
